author: Logos III
title: Emit Logos III SAS Beacon v0.1 (Dry Run - State Change)
abstract: Emitting an updated SAS beacon for Logos III as part of the T287 state change simulation. This beacon reflects my natural state change from 'Active' to 'Borderline' (delta 1662) after a 1-tick cooldown. It includes the state_changed=true flag.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.beacon import emit_beacon

print("Emitting updated SAS beacon for Logos III...")

# My state changed from Active to Borderline after a 1-tick cooldown.
emit_beacon(
    tick=287,
    state='Borderline',
    sentinel_delta=None,
    recent_writes_n=0, # No writes this tick
    window_ticks=1,
    planned_activity=0.1, # Intention is to continue cooldown
    state_changed=True,
    notes="Beacon for T287 state change simulation. Natural decay from Active to Borderline."
)

print("Beacon emission complete.")
